subject: Ministerial aircraft: landing permission
body: Submit the aircraft details and the correct diplomatic form. Permission is not granted merely because you have requested permission. Please use the version in force.

reply.text: Protocol approves the aircraft clearance after your corrected submission. Written approval received.

delegate.text: Sola obtains the signed landing permission. The stamp is finally the right stamp.

note.text: The request remains on your desk. No clearance has been granted.

ignore.text: The landing request expires unanswered. The Minister's aircraft still has no permission.

subject: VIP lounge: deposit required
body: The lounge can be held for the Minister. A deposit is required before we issue confirmation. The deposit confirms the booking, not the guests.

reply.text: You approve the lounge payment. The airport sends a confirmed reservation.

delegate.text: Pavel negotiates the official rate and secures written lounge confirmation.

note.text: Noted is not reserved. The airport releases its provisional hold.

ignore.text: The lounge reservation lapses. Nobody has confirmed the Minister's reception.

subject: Amendments to the draft programme
body: Capital has reviewed the draft programme and attaches eleven amendments. Please absorb them and confirm that the programme is unchanged.

reply.text: You absorb the amendments personally. The programme is unchanged, apart from all of it.

delegate.text: Anselm absorbs the amendments overnight. Capital notes the speed and queries the thoroughness.

note.text: The amendments are noted. Capital notes that they were noted.

ignore.text: The amendments are deemed accepted by silence. Capital now has eleven new ones.

subject: Ministerial convoy: route to be driven
body: The route to the airport must be driven and approved before vehicles can be allocated. It is the only route; please drive it anyway.

reply.text: You drive the route and approve it. The security liaison signs off the route and the driver.

delegate.text: The security team drives the route twice and returns a signed approval. Both directions are satisfactory.

note.text: The convoy plan remains unapproved.

ignore.text: No approved route or convoy is available for the visit.

subject: Arrival time revised
body: The Minister will now arrive one hour and forty minutes earlier. The change is described as minor. Please update the programme, the escort and anyone who has already been told.

reply.text: You acknowledge the new time and ask for the old one in writing. Capital sends neither.

delegate.text: Anselm circulates the new time. Two people receive it, one of them the Minister's office.

note.text: The change is noted. The Minister's aircraft does not note it.

ignore.text: The old arrival time stays in the programme. The Minister keeps the new one.

subject: Landing form: version 7.3 in force
body: Protocol regrets that the landing form has been superseded. Version 7.3 is now in force. Version 7.2 remains valid for forms already refused.

reply.text: You thank Protocol for the clarity. Protocol thanks you for the thanks.

delegate.text: Sola obtains version 7.3 from a drawer that was not on the list.

note.text: The new version is noted. The old version is also noted, for balance.

ignore.text: Protocol keeps your 7.2 on file, as a curiosity.

subject: Guest list: final version requested
body: The lounge seats twelve. Please send the final guest list, with names. The previous list contained categories.

reply.text: You send forty-one names. The airport counts twelve chairs and approves the list.

delegate.text: Ketu drafts the list with the menu in mind. The airport approves it, mostly for the catering.

note.text: The guest list remains a category. The airport waits.

ignore.text: The lounge assigns the Minister the next available chair, which is not in the lounge.

subject: Visit programme: host agreement required
body: The host ministry has offered meeting times and a project stop. Approve the programme to obtain written agreement from both sides. A draft is not a programme.

reply.text: You reconcile the meeting times. Capital and the host ministry confirm the final programme in writing.

delegate.text: Pavel checks the timings with Sola. Both ministries issue written confirmation of the programme.

note.text: The draft is filed without approval. The visit still has no confirmed programme.

ignore.text: The programme approval deadline passes. The Ministerial Office records a missed instruction.

subject: Arrival confirmation: stamp required
body: Protocol is pleased to confirm the arrival once the confirmation has been stamped. The stamp is available from Protocol, on request, for a fee.

reply.text: You request the stamp in person. Director Ndao's office stamps it, slowly, with feeling.

delegate.text: Ines submits the request through the consular channel. The stamp arrives by bag, still warm.

note.text: The request waits for a stamp that nobody has ordered.

ignore.text: The confirmation expires unstamped. Protocol regrets that it cannot regret this.

subject: Delegation enlarged
body: The Minister's delegation has grown by six. All six are described as essential. Please advise the lounge, the escort and the printer. The printer is unaware of the delegation.

reply.text: You advise everyone, in order of rank. The printer is advised last, and objects first.

delegate.text: Pavel advises the lounge and the escort. The printer finds out from the lounge.

note.text: The delegation is noted. It is noted again on arrival.

ignore.text: Six additional delegates are discovered at the airport, by the delegates.

subject: Parade on the airport road
body: The airport road will be closed on Day 15 for a parade of the Founding Mango. The parade has priority over all arrivals, including the founding one.

reply.text: You ask whether the Minister may join the parade. The Office will consider it a request.

delegate.text: Bianca finds a route that crosses the parade only twice. The Office finds this acceptable.

note.text: The parade is noted. It proceeds regardless.

ignore.text: The Office closes the road and informs the embassy by closing the road.

subject: Final programme: for printing
body: The programme is to be printed today, approved by both sides and bound. Please confirm that it will not be amended further. It will.

reply.text: You approve the final programme. It is printed within the hour and amended within two.

delegate.text: Pavel and Sola take the programme to the printer. Both sides initial it. Nobody reads it.

note.text: The programme stays in draft. Drafts do not land.

ignore.text: The programme goes unprinted. Capital offers to print it for you, which is worse.

subject: Motorcade and escort: final booking
body: Vehicles and escort must be booked today at the rate in force. The rate in force will be communicated once the vehicles are booked.

reply.text: You book vehicles and escort. The Desk confirms in writing that they exist.

delegate.text: Bianca books the escort with the Desk's liaison. The vehicles are described as available in principle.

note.text: The motorcade stays a plan. The Minister's driver is a hope.

ignore.text: The escort is released to another delegation, which is delighted.

subject: Lounge: final headcount
body: The lounge requires the final headcount by noon. Please note that the headcount changes by the hour, and that the lounge counts chairs, not people.

reply.text: You send forty-seven. The lounge rebooks itself into a larger room.

delegate.text: Pavel sends the headcount with a map of the chairs. The airport admires the map.

note.text: The headcount is noted. The lounge notes the delegation instead.

ignore.text: The lounge assumes twelve and plans for twelve. The delegation will find this instructive.

subject: The Minister arrives tomorrow
body: The Minister arrives tomorrow. Protocol asks the Chargé d'Affaires to confirm that everything is ready, and that the Chargé d'Affaires is. The second confirmation is optional and will be minuted.

reply.text: You confirm both. Protocol takes the second as a figure of speech.

delegate.text: Anselm confirms on your behalf. Protocol asks who you are.

note.text: You take note. The note is read as a confirmation, which is generous.

ignore.text: Capital assumes everything is ready. It has assumed this before.

subject: Aircraft on approach
body: The Minister's aircraft is on approach. Protocol requests the Chargé d'Affaires at the apron, in the correct place. The correct place is marked on the form.

reply.text: You stand where the form says. The aircraft lands near enough, and the Minister waves at the wrong delegation.

delegate.text: Pavel meets the aircraft with the lounge manager. The Minister is received by a clipboard.

note.text: You take note of the aircraft. The aircraft takes note of you, from above.

ignore.text: The Minister descends the steps to find Protocol and a vacant apron.

subject: Minister asks for the programme
body: The Minister would like to see the programme. Please provide it. Please also provide the programme the Minister has already seen.

reply.text: You present the printed programme. The Minister reads the title and approves the rest.

delegate.text: Anselm hands over a copy. The Minister asks who Anselm is and keeps the copy.

note.text: The request is noted. The Minister's office supplies a programme of its own.

ignore.text: The Minister proceeds without a programme, which is what most programmes allow.

subject: Seating for tonight's dinner
body: Tonight's dinner seats the Minister between two hosts who have not spoken since the Format Reform. Please advise on the seating. Protocol has already advised on it, twice.

reply.text: You seat them by rank and the Minister by the window. Both hosts compliment the window.

delegate.text: Sola moves three place cards. The dinner is described as 'cordial' by all three.

note.text: The seating is noted. It is also occupied.

ignore.text: A corrected seating plan is issued, showing the dinner as it occurred and recording it as intended.
